clusters.label: Value fleet / price-led (< S$2,000)
clusters.rationale: Could serve some standard-fleet needs, but the lowest-price battle is not where this brand's differentiation is strongest — treat as a tactical/legacy zone, not a target battlefield, even where it looks like a large pool.
clusters.competitorNote: Entry-level SKUs from mainstream OEMs and generic ODM fleet deals compete almost entirely on price here.

clusters.label: Core corporate-business (S$2,000–S$2,999)
clusters.rationale: Likely bulk business-fleet territory for mainstream knowledge workers — the primary hypothesis for where real, repeatable fleet volume sits.
clusters.competitorNote: Mainstream enterprise fleet lines (ThinkPad, EliteBook/ProBook, Latitude-class) are the direct competitive set.

clusters.label: Premium Mobile (S$3,000–S$3,999)
clusters.rationale: A real but role-based opportunity inside the same target accounts (senior/mobile users), not the whole fleet — treat as an upsell layer on top of the core-corporate hypothesis, not a separate target.
clusters.competitorNote: Premium-ultraportable executive lines compete here on weight and build quality.

clusters.label: Specialist / workstation (S$4,000+)
clusters.rationale: Selective executive/specialist demand only, and often requires workstation-class discrete GPU — a hard product exclusion for the current range.
clusters.competitorNote: Dedicated workstation lines (Precision, ZBook, ThinkPad P-series) own this segment.
